about: Built by tools/build_concord.py. The Concord Museum publishes no floor plan: this one is approximate, drawn inside the building’s real outline (aerial imagery) from the museum’s own descriptions: the Gateway entrance with admissions and the shop, restrooms, elevator and coat rack on the first floor, the April 19 galleries upstairs. Which room holds which gallery is a guess.
source: Approximate: Esri World Imagery outline; Concord Museum Plan Your Visit, Families, Groups and What’s On pages; Fall 2021 newsletter
